scope: Release delta: recommended levels, successful-row reset, output-directory persistence, version metadata and acceptance documentation. Earlier custom-variation implementation review is recorded separately.

review.execution: Sequential main-thread review as required by AGENTS.md; no independent reviewer or cross-model review claimed.
checks: Reset checks native idle and actual success under the service mutex; retains old job/history/output and deduplication key, creates new item/job identity and preserves position.
New queue structure cannot be replaced by stale responses; reset selection invalidates old log generations and late job events do not bind to the new row.
Frontend reset ref lock prevents same-event duplicate reset/start; native validation remains authoritative.
Output-directory persistence stores only a local preference, catches storage failures and ignores canceled/unmounted/late-batch picker responses; native output checks remain unchanged.
Rust recommendations, frontend fixtures and assertions match the six requested levels; existing saved custom levels are not migrated or overwritten.
New reset command is registered and mirrored in DesktopApi; it accepts only an item identity and does not expose filesystem or shell privileges.
Version entries agree across the five application manifests/lockfiles; no media, credentials or generated build products are included in the release delta.

coverageLimits: Local browser checks use an isolated test DesktopApi; they are not native dialog or installed application acceptance.
Output-directory restart is covered through frontend remount and real localStorage; installed native restart remains a manual acceptance step.
Same-commit dual-platform CI build, installed-resource and installed-media evidence must pass before publication.
Signing, notarization and full clean-machine desktop acceptance remain NOT VERIFIED.
